question: In a trapezium, the lengths of the two parallel sides are 6 and 10 units. If one of the oblique sides has length 1 unit, then the length of the other oblique side must be

options.A: greater than 3 units but less than 4 units
options.B: greater than 3 units but less than 5 units
options.C: less than or equal to 3 units
options.D: greater than 5 units but less than 6 units

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
